## Gladys 5.3 music player

**Requires Gladys 5.3 or later.**

### Added

- The **Subsonic jukebox** is now a player of the Gladys 5.3 **Music** widget:
  artwork, title, artist, album, a progress bar you can drag to seek,
  play/pause, previous/next and volume. The next song shows within seconds of
  the end of the current one, even with a 60 s polling interval.
- Music panel: browse **Albums**, **Artists** and **Playlists**, search the
  library (artists, albums, playlists, songs), see the jukebox queue and jump
  to a song, play an item now, **next** or **at the end** of the queue.
- Scene action **Play music on a speaker** (`music.play-media`): play an album, an artist,
  a playlist or a song on the jukebox.
- The playback state of the jukebox can be set from a scene: 0 pause, 1 play,
  2 stop (pause and back to the start of the song).
- Configuration field **Language of the music panel** (French by default) for
  the panel's folders and messages.

### Changed

- The playback state reads **2 (stopped)** when the queue is empty, has played
  to its end, or was stopped by Gladys; it read 0 before. A scene waiting for
  "= 0" no longer fires at the end of the queue.
- A jukebox already added to Gladys gets the new features through **Update** in
  the integration's **Discover** tab. Its ids do not change: scenes and
  dashboards keep working.

The Subsonic API has no shuffle mode, repeat or mute for the jukebox: the
player does not show those buttons. Navidrome reserves the jukebox to
administrators by default (`Jukebox.AdminOnly`).
